excluded8_scope: full inference / clean annotation subset diagnostic only

definitions.false_Birth_proxy: New delivered global ID despite exactly one clean matching prior ACTIVE object; outcome attribution, not proof of Birth-head miscalibration.
definitions.NULL_proxy: Unique clean matching prior active ID serialized missed>0 although a current clean detection exists; ambiguous duplicate histories excluded.
definitions.cumulative_contamination: All clean labels ever assigned to a delivered ID; never forgets a prior error. Does not assert embedding contamination.
definitions.occlusion_limit: Detection gaps are separated by whether GT was absent in any intermediate frame. GT absence may be occlusion/out-of-view/annotation absence; it is not a visibility ground-truth sensor.
definitions.IDSW_vs_CVIDF1: Local per-camera changes and global one-to-one cross-view identity agreement measure different errors. Stable view-specific or wrongly merged IDs may have few local changes but poor global association.
definitions.clean_graph: One-to-one Hungarian overlap on clean IoU=.5 matched detections only, per-scene disjoint IDs; not TrackEval or MATLAB CVIDF1.
